title: botrypus virginianus
intro: Botrypus virginianus, commonly known as the American flying polypody or resurrection fern, is a species of fern native to the southeastern United States. This plant is known for its unique ability to survive in a desiccated state, regaining its green color and resuming photosynthesis when it is exposed to moisture. The health benefits of Botrypus virginianus include its potential to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities.
